source:
Kirara Tomoe is a blonde girl who attends Hoshimiya Daini Gakuen. The girl who was first seen by the familiar Emma transforms into a magical girl, Magical Kirara, who fights against the "seed of Makaiju"!

However, the boys and teachers who made their desires runaway with the power of seeds could not go straight. Deflowering, anal sex, and even sex classes in front of classmates! ??

Still, she is a childhood friend, thinking of Tadashi and doing her best, but she is pressed by an evil classmate Akira who is aiming for Kirara ...! ??

A cute magical girl drowns in a deep world of flesh!
An immoral magical story in which a childhood friend's innocence falls into an NTR crisis!

translation:
Kirara Tomoe是就读于星宫第二学园的金发女孩。熟悉的艾玛第一次见到的女孩，变身为与“魔界兽之种”战斗的魔法少女——魔法基拉拉！

然而，利用种子的力量让欲望失控的男孩和老师却无法直行。摘花、肛交，甚至在同学面前上性爱课！??

尽管如此，她还是青梅竹马，想着正并竭尽全力，但她却受到了以基拉拉为目标的邪恶同学阿基拉的压力……！??

可爱的魔法少女被淹没在深深的肉体世界里！
青梅竹马的纯真陷入NTR危机的不道德魔法故事！
